tha-ap507:1.1: Pāraphaliya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ / rathiyaṃ patipajjantaṃ pāraphalam adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap507:2.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap507:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pāraphaliyo thero i. g. a-ti.
